content: Pool Nɗǝǝn Yil mMalta
Aɓwoon ɗe mu wul nɗǝǝn yil nǝ nkoom jir, ɓǝ mu kǝlǝng nǝ, moo pet sǝm yil ɗe am neer nǝ cǝǝrkaat a Malta.
Nenyil nǝ mo kaat mun jir, kǝzak mo ɓam mun zam, ɓǝ mo ɓil wus mmun, mbǝɗe fwan nkaa jì, kǝ pee zuum zak.
Ɗangɓǝ kaaɗe Pool kok yoom le nwus, ɓǝ mbǝ tal mǝ wus nǝ, ɓǝ mee nwòo ɗe sǝm nǝ a pang, nǝ pus sar mPool, ɗang nǝ ɗyiin nkaa sar wur.

Kaaɗe nenyil nǝ mo naa nwòo ɗesǝ nii ɗyiin mPool nkaa sar, ɓǝ mo sat nshak nǝnee, <<Azeen-zeen gwar ɗesǝ wur a ngutukáa, koo ɗewur kǝ put mɓut njeel mǝ am kuur nǝ, ɓǝ baa kwat mǝ shikbish nǝ mak yit wur ɗe mmeen kas.>>
Ɓǝ Pool vwet nwòo nǝ sham taa nwus. Mbǝɗǝ nwòo ɗe nǝ pus wur nǝ, ɓǝ baa nǝ cìn mee mbii nwur kas.

Nenyil nǝ mo pan nǝ, yak mon nnaa Pool wup, koo mo nnaa wur taa nyil muut. Ɗangɓǝ kaaɗe mo tong naapee, ɓǝ baa mo naa mee mbii cìn Pool kas, ɓǝ mo waa sheepwoo ɗe, mo sat nǝnee, <<Gwar ɗesǝ wur a mee naan.>>
Kus kǝ peemǝnǝ, ɓǝ mee maar mǝ Pubiliyus ngwe ɗeɗes nkaa yil ɗe am neer cǝǝrkaat nǝ, wur kaat mun le nlu fin mbǝ teer mo kun, ɗang wur tap kǝ mun, wur cìn ɗeret mmun zam.
Puun mǝ Pubiliyus, baa wur nkoom kas, wur a peesaam kǝ shikshwal, kǝ ɗyestoom zak. Pool ɗel pǝ ngunan nǝ ɗi, ɓǝ wur ɗangnaan ɓǝ wur lesar fin nkaa ngunan nǝ, ɓǝ ngunan nǝ bar.
Kaaɗe Pool cìn mǝnǝ, ɓǝ koor nengok ɗe mo nɗǝǝn yil ɗe am neer cǝǝrkaat nǝ, mo jì jir, mbǝkǝ mPool bar mo ɗi.
Nenyil nǝ mo shin zuum mo mmun ɗes, ɗang kaaɗe mun mbǝ ɗel nɗǝǝn tii nǝ mbǝ seet, ɓǝ mo shin mbii ɗe mon mɓam mun a ar mwaan nǝ jir zak.
Pool Wul nRom

Aɓwoon tar mo kun, ɓǝ mǝ yool nɗǝǝn mee tii ɗe nǝ tong a Alekzandriya jì, ɗe nii hos ntarkut nɗǝǝn yil ɗe am neer cǝǝrkaat sǝ. tii ɗesǝ nǝ kǝ sǝmpwoo (alaama) mǝ káa Jan ɗemish mo nkaa nǝ, ɗe mo a Kasto, kǝ Pollukus, mee naan mǝ mo, nǝ mo.
Mu jì mǝ wul nSirakus, ɓǝ mu cìn teer mo kun ɗi, mpee mǝnǝ.
Kaaɗe mu yool mpee mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mu jì mu wul nRegiyum. Mu teer mpeemǝnǝ, ɓǝ mee kut yool nkor ngyeen, ɓǝ ɗaar nǝ, ɓǝ mu dǝm mu wul mPutiyoli.
Mu kat nenseet nɗang Jesu mo mpeemǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo ɗang mun kǝn mmun cìn teer mo pwoovǝl ɗi ashak kǝ mo. A mwaan fun nǝ mmǝnǝ, ɗee mu dǝm mu wul nRom.

Kaaɗe nenseet nɗang Jesu ɗe mon mpee nkaam nRom, mo kǝlǝng pwoo nkaa mun, ɓǝ mo pwat jì mbǝ kaat mun, ɓǝ mo jì wul mpeepring Apiyus, kǝ pee ɗe lumǝzep mo ɗekun. Kaaɗe Pool naa mo, ɓǝ wur plang Naan, ɗang pǝtuup wur nǝ sǝǝt katɓal.
Kaaɗe mu jì mu wul nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nRom, ɓǝ mo shínpee mPool tong ɗi mbǝshin mpee ɗewur rǝɓet, ashak kǝ shiitoon ɗewur kǝ tap Pool.
Pool Sat Pwoo Naan Nɗǝǝn Pee Nkaam nRom

Aɓwoon teer mo kun, ɓǝ Pool pǝrep nen ɗenan-nan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo. Kaaɗe mo kuur ashak, ɓǝ wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Ɗyemnaa mo, baa kǝn cìn mee mbii ɗebish nnen fun mo kas. Koo a nkaa mǝse mǝ wàar puun fun mo, ɓǝ baa kǝn cìn mee mbii ɗebish kas, jir kǝsǝ, ɓǝ mo yaa an shin nnen Rom mo a ɓuɓwoot nɗǝǝn yil nJerusalem.
Kaaɗe nnen Rom mo tokɗyeel nghan, ɓǝ mo rǝɓet ɓwet an, mbǝɗe baa kǝn cìn mee mbii ɗebish ɗe nǝ mak kǝ mmo tu an kas.
Ɗangɓǝ baa nnen Yahudi mo rǝɓet kǝ mmo ɓwet an kas, ɓǝ nǝ ɗee nghan a tǝng kǝn nghan ɗang nǝ, mo jì kǝ ɗyeel fen nǝ pǝ Siza ɗi. Baa nǝ, kǝn rǝɓet yap a nen fun mo kǝ ɗyeel kas.
A mbǝ pwoo ɗesǝ, ɓǝ wen nyappee ɗe an nnaa wun ɗi, mbǝkǝ wen leshap ɗi kǝ wun, mbǝɗe a mbǝ canciin ɗe nnen Isreil mo kǝ nǝ, ɗang an ɗi a ɓuɓwoot shi shoolbǝring ɗesǝ.>>

Mo sat nwur nǝnee, <<Baa mmun muu kat mee lep a rǝran nyil Judiya nkaa gha kas. Kǝzak baa mee ɗyemnǝǝn fun mo jì mpee ɗesǝ, kǝn mmo satpwoo ɗi mmun nkaa gha, koo mo sat mee pwoo mmun nkaa mbii ɗebish ɗe a cìn mo kas zak.
Ɗangɓǝ mu rǝɓet kǝlǝng nǝ mpwoo fwaa mbii ɗe gha naa nǝ ret, mbǝɗe katɗang a pwoo nkaa Ar ɗesǝ nǝ, ɓǝ mu man nǝ, koo a nii, ɓǝ mo nkaa leshap ɗebish nkaa nǝ.>>

Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo lepuus. Ɓǝ kaaɗe puus nǝ wul, ɓǝ gurum mo ɗes mo jì pǝ Pool ɗi a pee ɗewur kǝ tong ɗi. Yool mbít, dǝm wul nkansǝǝn, ɓǝ Pool kámshii mǝ mulki mǝ Naan nǝ ngurum mo, ɗang wur tong a langtǝng nkaa nǝ zak. Wur rǝɓet dul mo jì pǝ Jesu ɗi, shi kám mǝ Wàar mǝ Mosis, kǝ shi kám mǝ nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo zak.
Pak gurum nǝ mo shinzeen mpwoo ɗewur sat nǝ, ɗang baa pak mo shinzeen kas.

Kaaɗe baa mo kǝlǝngkar nǝ ashak jir kas, ɓǝ akuɗang moo rangkáa, ɓǝ Pool sat mee pwoo mmo mǝndong, nǝnee, <<Azeen-zeen pwoo ɗe gyet Riin Ɗeɓang wur kǝ sat mpuun fuu mo nsar kǝ ngusat pwoo Naan Aizaya nǝnee,

<A dǝm pǝ nnen ɗesǝ mo ɗi, kǝn nghan sat mmo nǝnee, wun nsat a kǝlǝngpee, ɗang baa wun mmanshii mǝ mbii ɗe wun kǝlǝng nǝ kas koo dǝɓen. Wun nsat a nnaapee ɗak, ɗang baa wun mmanshii mǝ mbii ɗe wuu naa nǝ kas koo dǝɓen.

Mbǝɗǝ pǝtuup mǝ nnen ɗesǝ nǝ mo fii ɗee kakras. Mo kǝ duur kom fur mo, ɗang mo kǝ kup ar fur mo zak. Mbǝkǝ taji mo naapee shi yit fur mo, kǝ taji mo kǝlǝngpee shi kom fur mo zak, kǝzak, mbǝkǝ taji mo manshii nǝ nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fur mo. Kǝn mmo ciir pǝ an ɗi, ɓǝ yool an ɓam mo.>
<<Mbǝ mǝnǝ, ɓǝ wen nrǝɓǝt kǝ nwun man nǝ, mo kǝ lep pwoo nkaa ɓam mǝ Naan nǝ shindǝm nnen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas. Yaksǝ mon nlekom mbǝ pwoo nǝ, ɓǝ mon nkǝlǝng.>>
Kaaɗe Pool leshap ɗesǝ mmo, ɓǝ nnen Yahudi mo rangkáa, kǝ mon nkaa ɓeetpwoo nǝ kǝ shak.
Pool tong nɗǝǝn lu ɗe a wur kwat shikáa fin, mbǝ ɓit mo vǝl. Wur kǝ kaat nen ɗe mo jì pǝ wur ɗi jir.
Wur leshap ngurum mo nkaa mulki mǝ Naan nǝ, baa ashak kǝ mee kǝǝrmuut kas, kǝ baa mee ngwe cíi nwur kas, kǝzak, wur kámpwoo ngurum mo nkaa Daa Jesu Kristi.
